headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to speed up the building of broadband internet infrastructure.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this 2012 order tells federal agencies to take steps to speed up the building of high-speed internet networks. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, deadlines, and agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to help speed up broadband construction, though the specific duties are not described in the available material.
They may be affected by federal efforts to make broadband construction faster, but the details are not given.
